title: Leaf Outlines
description: Makes leaves transparent with an outline. Makes clearing trees much easier!
body:
This pack makes leaves transparent, except for an outline. This way, large oak trees and mangrove trees can be cleared out much easier! The outline makes sure you don't fall through the leaves.

![Trees with clear leaves with an outline, mountainside, oak, birch trees, jungle in the background](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d1d4721af22b25aefba00aeec607b94e975c8437.png)

I found that other resource packs are made for older versions of the game, and I wanted to make a modern one.
